sourceCommitScope.byteIdentityAuthority: Current byte-identity of sourceFiles and packagingFiles is established solely by their sha256 values, checked against the tracked tree by tools/verify-source-provenance.ts. Nothing in this file depends on sourceCommit for either guarantee.
